predicates.label: canonical reread shape
predicates.fact: _saved_document selects the canonical parent/shot/internal image fields before bundle_from_document; this is the prior seam fixed by the earlier setup delta

predicates.label: physical source root selection
predicates.fact: the patch targets the source shot revision alias and declares an empty prior items value

predicates.label: provider registration and call
predicates.fact: the immutable Runtime registers the astrid provider and invokes the canonical commit route

predicates.label: source map custody
predicates.fact: an un-copied source shot retains source pins with an empty item_id_map; bundle conversion does not allocate a new item

predicates.label: correspondence guard
predicates.fact: shot_item_map authenticates source pins, derives the expected item set from the baseline, and _item_ids rejects any candidate set that differs; here expected is empty while candidate has one row

predicates.label: Runtime acceptance/persistence boundary
predicates.fact: Runtime persists canonical child rows and shot_items only after provider validation returns; this boundary is not reached for the candidate row

predicates.label: canonical reread after acceptance
predicates.fact: revision_closure reconstructs canonical images from stored rows and the fixture rereads only after an accepted response; no post-patch reread exists in the failing run

predicates.label: duplicate identity path
predicates.fact: duplicate authoring creates placement-local item identities and a source-to-authoring item_id_map, but the failing fixture never reaches these calls

classification.root_cause_class: unallocated physical membership introduced through a strict correspondence-checked patch
classification.owner: Agent provider identity/correspondence guard, with fixture setup assuming a creation route that is not established by the request
